summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its daily open-market share repurchase under the buy-back announced 5 August 2026. On 25 September 2026 it bought 871,200 ordinary shares of US$0.50 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange via BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC, at HK$155.70–HK$157.90, volume-weighted average HK$156.7755. Cumulative repurchases since launch total 47,745,902 shares for approximately US$979.4m; shares are purchased for cancellation, leaving issued capital and total voting rights of 17,141,942,291. No UK-venue purchases occurred that day. Watch execution pace versus the programme's total authorization and any acceleration or suspension signals.
